Evidence was heard during the Inquest that a CD Oxygen cylinder manufactured by BOC was used during the resuscitation of Ben. I was shown during the Inquest how the oxygen cylinder is operated.
confusion of two valves on oxygen cylinder

It is understood that BCUHB have referred numerous concerns to BOC over recent years and some minor amendments have been made to the cylinders. BCUHB also reported to the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) on 6 October 2022 under The Yellow Card Scheme. No response was formally received.
lack of response to safety concerns

I remain concerned that the CD Oxygen cylinders manufactured by BOC which, it is understood, supply most if not all Health Boards in Wales (under procurement processes) are unsafe for use in heightened / pressurised situations in that it is not overtly clear how the cylinders are to be operated with the confusion of the two valves. This is evidenced by very similar ongoing issues identified by BCUHB even with adequate training of staff.
unsafe operation of CD Oxygen cylinders
